scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@smart-school/shared-types run build && npm --workspace=@smart-school/shared-utils run build && npm --workspace=@smart-school/validation run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace=@smart-school/api run build && npm --workspace=@smart-school/web run build && npm --workspace=@smart-school/desktop run build
scripts.test: cross-env TEMP=D:/temp TMP=D:/temp npm --workspace=@smart-school/api run test && cross-env TEMP=D:/temp TMP=D:/temp npm --workspace=@smart-school/web run test
scripts.test:api: cross-env TEMP=D:/temp TMP=D:/temp npm --workspace=@smart-school/api run test
scripts.test:web: cross-env TEMP=D:/temp TMP=D:/temp npm --workspace=@smart-school/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@smart-school/shared-types run typecheck && npm --workspace=@smart-school/shared-utils run typecheck && npm --workspace=@smart-school/validation run typecheck && npm --workspace=@smart-school/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@smart-school/web run typecheck && npm --workspace=@smart-school/desktop run typecheck
